key.name: layout-json
key.description: Stores widget types, sizes, desktop positions, per-widget visibility and target monitor as JSON.

key.name: monitor-index
key.description: Index of the monitor widgets are shown on. -1 uses the primary monitor.

key.name: grid-size
key.description: Snap grid size in pixels used when positioning widgets.

key.name: widget-gap
key.description: Spacing in pixels between widgets and the screen edges.

key.name: snap-to-grid
key.description: Whether widget positions snap to the grid while dragging.

key.name: lock-widgets
key.description: Disable dragging and resizing of widgets.

key.name: hide-all
key.description: Hide every desktop widget without removing its configuration.

key.name: edit-mode
key.description: Show edit controls so widgets can be moved and removed.

key.name: widget-opacity
key.description: Opacity of widgets as a percentage (10-100).

key.name: show-panel-icon
key.description: Whether the Desktop Widget icon is shown in the top panel.

key.name: photos-source
key.description: Which source the Photos widget uses: local, immich or mixed.

key.name: photo-interval
key.description: How often the Photos widget switches to another image, in seconds.

key.name: immich-server-url
key.description: Base URL of the Immich server, for example https://immich.example.com.

key.name: immich-api-key
key.description: API key used to authenticate requests to the Immich server.

key.name: immich-scope
key.description: Which Immich photos to use: all, favorites or a specific album.

key.name: immich-album-id
key.description: Identifier of the Immich album to use when the scope is set to album.

key.name: immich-size
key.description: Thumbnail rendition requested from Immich: thumbnail, preview or fullsize.
